claim.claim-text: a sole structure (114) configured to support thereon a foot of a user; and an upper (112) attached to the sole structure (114) and configured to support thereon the foot of the user, the upper (112) including an upper segment fabricated from an engineered textile (132), the engineered textile (132) including:
2. The article of footwear of claim 1, wherein each of the joints includes a respective lockstitch of a first thread (144) and a second thread (146).
3. The article of footwear of claim 2, wherein the first and second threads (144, 146) are elongated in a third direction (D3) substantially parallel with respect to the first direction (D1).

4. The article of footwear of claim 2 or claim 3, wherein the first and second sets of wire windings (140, 142) have a first diameter, the first thread (144) has a second diameter less than the first diameter, and the second thread (146) has a third diameter less than the first diameter, wherein, optionally, the first diameter is at least 50-75% larger or at least 100-200% larger or 3-times to 4-times larger than the second and third diameters.

5. The article of footwear of any one of claims 2 to 4, wherein the first thread (144) is a top thread that abuts the first and second sets of wire windings (140, 142) in an unwoven, intercrossed pattern.
6. The article of footwear of any one of claims 2 to 5, wherein the first and second threads (144, 146) form a first plurality of substantially linear stitch seams.

7. The article of footwear of claim 6, wherein each stitch seam in the first plurality of substantially linear stitch seams extends substantially parallel to the first direction (D1) and is interleaved with and bind together a respective pair of wire windings in the first set of wire windings (140).

8. The article of footwear of claim 7, wherein the first plurality of substantially linear stitch seams is elongated in a third direction (D3) that is substantially parallel with respect to the first direction (D1) of the first set of windings (140), wherein, optionally, the first and second threads (144, 146) form a second plurality of substantially linear stitch seams elongated in a fourth direction (D4) that is substantially parallel with respect to the second direction (D2) of the second set of windings (142).

9. The article of footwear of claim 8, wherein each stitch seam in the second plurality of stitch seams extends substantially parallel to the second direction (D2) and is interleaved with a respective pair of wire windings in the second set of wire windings (142).

10. The article of footwear of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the unwoven, intercrossed pattern of the first and second sets of wire windings (140, 142) defines a plurality of quadrangles with central gaps, and wherein the first and second threads (144, 146) are lockstitched together in the central gaps.

11. The article of footwear of claim 10, wherein each of the quadrangles is defined by a respective set of intersecting points at which the first set of wire windings (140) intercrosses the second set of wire windings (142), and wherein each of the joints is located at a respective center of a diagonal line segment connecting an opposing pair of the intersecting points.
12. The article of footwear of any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the first and second sets of wire windings (140, 142) are retained in a tensioned state in the unwoven, intercrossed pattern.

13. The article of footwear any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the first set of wire windings (140) is located on top of the second set of wire windings (142), and wherein the first and second sets of wire windings (140, 142) are assembled in a manner that allows for relative wire movement and/or wire-on-wire translation.

14. The article of footwear of claim 13, wherein the first set of wire windings (140) is translatable with respect to the second set of wire windings (142) in the first direction (D1), and the second set of wire windings (142) is translatable with respect to the first set of wire windings (140) in the second direction (D2).

15. The article of footwear of any one of claims 1 to 14, wherein the first set of wire windings (140) is formed from a first wire strand, the second set of wire windings (142) is formed from a second wire strand, and each of the first and second wire strands is formed from an aliphatic or semi-aromatic polyamide fiber, an aromatic polyester fiber, an aramid fiber, a polypropylene fiber, and/or a high modulus polyethylene fiber.
